SELECT COUNT(*) as product_count, category FROM dim_product 
WHERE category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY category

SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_year, d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date 
FROM dim_date d
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
ORDER BY d.fiscal_week_end_date

SELECT 
  AVG(fws.closing_value) as average_stock_value_at_cost
FROM fact_stock_week fws
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fws.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND dp.is_current = TRUE
  AND fws.week_ending_date IN ('2026-07-05', '2026-07-12', '2026-07-19', '2026-07-26', '2026-08-02')

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as record_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fws.store_key) as store_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dp.product_key) as product_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fws.week_ending_date) as week_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fws.closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_values,
  MIN(fws.closing_value) as min_value,
  MAX(fws.closing_value) as max_value,
  AVG(fws.closing_value) as avg_value
FROM fact_stock_week fws
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fws.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND dp.is_current = TRUE
  AND fws.week_ending_date IN ('2026-07-05', '2026-07-12', '2026-07-19', '2026-07-26', '2026-08-02')

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as product_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN delisted_on < '2026-06-29' THEN 1 END) as delisted_before_period,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN delisted_on IS NULL THEN 1 END) as still_listed
FROM dim_product
WHERE category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND is_current = TRUE
  AND product_key NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT fws.product_key
    FROM fact_stock_week fws
    WHERE fws.week_ending_date IN ('2026-07-05', '2026-07-12', '2026-07-19', '2026-07-26', '2026-08-02')
  )

SELECT 
  dp.product_key,
  dp.sku,
  dp.product_name,
  dp.listed_from,
  dp.delisted_on,
  MAX(fws.week_ending_date) as latest_stock_record
FROM dim_product dp
LEFT JOIN fact_stock_week fws ON dp.product_key = fws.product_key
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND dp.is_current = TRUE
  AND dp.product_key NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT fws.product_key
    FROM fact_stock_week fws
    WHERE fws.week_ending_date IN ('2026-07-05', '2026-07-12', '2026-07-19', '2026-07-26', '2026-08-02')
  )
  AND dp.delisted_on IS NULL
GROUP BY dp.product_key, dp.sku, dp.product_name, dp.listed_from, dp.delisted_on

FROM fact_stock_week fws
